name: What should I consider before planning a garage addition to my home?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider before planning a garage addition to my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before planning a garage addition, consider its primary purpose—whether for additional parking, a workshop, storage, or converting into a living space. Assess your property's available space, local zoning regulations, and how the addition will impact your yard or property lines. It's also beneficial to gather inspirational ideas and determine a realistic budget range. Understanding these aspects helps us tailor a customized renovation plan that aligns with your vision and enhances your home's long-term value. AKN Design Group focuses on guiding homeowners through these initial considerations during our consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before a garage addition, consider its purpose, available property space, local zoning, and your budget. Understanding these factors helps us create a customized renovation plan.
